sources.citation: Mu'jizah. 2018. Preservasi dan Revitalisasi Bahasa dan Sastra Nafri, Papua: Sebuah Bahasa Hampir Punah. Aksara 30(1): 75-88. DOI 10.29255/aksara.v30i1.217.75-88
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Revitalisation report; its literature review lists the descriptive works on Nafri (Kafiar, Fautngil & Kameubu 1987 Struktur Bahasa Nafri; Dharmojo 1992; Masreng 2002; Martinbongs 2015 Metalingua 13(2); Setyowati dkk 2016 Bahan Ajar Bahasa Nafri; Fautngil 1995 UI thesis; Suharyanto 2009 UGM thesis). No phonological content; silent on stress.

sources.citation: Supiyanto; Kmurawak, Remuz; Mandowen, Samuel Aleksander. 2018. Pengembangan Kamus Bahasa Daerah Nafri dengan Program Delphi. Universitas Cenderawasih e-journal, 8 pp. (CORE 228786763).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.citation: Sanjoko, Yohanis. 2013. Kekerabatan Bahasa Nafri, Sentani, dan Tabla. Gramatika: Jurnal Ilmiah Kebahasaan dan Kesastraan 1(1): 41-54. DOI 10.31813/gramatika/1.1.2013.16.41--54 (via Internet Archive copy of gramatika.kemdikbud.go.id)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Lexicostatistic (200-item Swadesh) kinship study of Nafri, Sentani, Tabla; no phonology section; nothing on tekanan/stress. This is the 'Sanjoko 2013' that Glottolog and the earlier scan named.

sources.citation: Sanjoko, Yohanis. 2011. Hubungan Kekerabatan Bahasa Nafri dan Bahasa Sentani. Kibas Cenderawasih: Jurnal Ilmiah Kebahasaan dan Kesastraan 7(2): 91-106. Jayapura: Balai Bahasa Provinsi Papua.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Image-only scan, scanned (tesseract ind+eng, 150 dpi). Lexical/phonological-correspondence kinship paper; cites Kafiar dkk. (1985) for the Nafri phoneme inventory (26 phonemes: 20 consonants, 6 vowels /i e ə a u o/); nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Widodo, Supriyanto; Suharyanto; Sitti Mariati S; Arman. 2007. Pemertahanan Bahasa Nafri. Jayapura: Balai Bahasa Jayapura, Pusat Bahasa, Departemen Pendidikan Nasional. ISBN 978-979-17800-2-5. 119-page scan (CORE 227147441 = oai:repositori.kemdikbud.go.id:3338).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sociolinguistic language-maintenance survey (questionnaire statistics, Bab I-IV); no structural description; silent on stress.

sources.citation: Cowan, H. K. J. 1965. Grammar of the Sentani Language, with specimen texts and vocabulary. (Verhandelingen van het KITLV 47.) 's-Gravenhage: Martinus Nijhoff. (OAPEN open access, handle 20.500.12657/32169)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Describes Eastern Sentani (nucl1632), not Nafri. II.4.1 'Stress' pp. 9-10: Sentani stress 'lies as a rule on the syllabic preceding the last consonant of the word', with secondary stress and irregularities. The only Nafri datum is incidental, p. 10: "Sometimes differences in stress exist between different dialects, e.g., ka'ji, 'big (women's) canoe', but 'kaji in the central dialect; 'hodo, 'throat', but sə'to in Nafri and sə'so in Tanah Merah; etc." No stress rule is stated for Nafri.

sources.citation: Kafiar, August; Fautngil, C; Kameubu, A. 1987. Struktur bahasa Nafri: Fonologi. Jayapura: Universitas Cenderawasih, Proyek Penelitian Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia dan Daerah (Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa). vii+107 pp.

sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: The only dedicated phonology of Nafri (107 pp.); reports in this Pusat Bahasa series routinely include a 'fonem suprasegmental / tekanan' subsection that states whether stress is distinctive and where it falls. Cited by Sanjoko 2011 (as 1985) for the segment inventory and by Mu'jizah 2018.

sources.citation: Cowan, H. K. J. 1952-53. De Austronesisch-Papoea'se taalgrens in de onderafdeling Hollandia (Nieuw-Guinea). Tijdschrift Nieuw-Guinea 13.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Cowan's survey of the Hollandia-area languages including Nafri; his 1965 grammar shows he recorded Nafri stress on individual words, so the earlier survey may have a general remark.
